0022600169.text: The Denver Nuggets (3-2, third in the Northwest and one game back, 8th in the West) host the Portland Trail Blazers (4-1, first in the Northwest and 3rd in the West), with Denver riding a two-game winning streak and Portland on a one-game streak after going 3-0 on the road. Denver is missing Alpha Diallo (wrist sprain), Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring), while Portland is without Ja Morant (hamstring) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery). The teams have not met yet this season, and the Nuggets won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 137-132 regular-season win in Denver in their last meeting.
